text:
Maria (People Ops): Heads-up: Rita's background check flagged an identity mismatch between her CPF record and the passport name. She's remote in Brazil and said she's renewing her passport.

Diego (HR Partner): OK. For Brazil remote hires Legal allows one of: 1) in-person notary at consulate, 2) certified digital notary + recorded video showing original doc, or 3) local notary + couriered certified copy. We should avoid holding start date if we can verify via video.

Maria (People Ops): Which is fastest? Rita, can you confirm if you can do a short recorded Zoom or WhatsApp video with original passport and CPF card visible?

Rita (New Hire): I can do a WhatsApp video call tonight at 7pm BRT. I also have the renewal receipt for my passport. Is a recorded WhatsApp acceptable?

Diego (HR Partner): Recorded video OK but we need: (a) you hold each doc up to camera, (b) read a short attestation script, (c) state your full name and DOB, and (d) consent to Redwood storing the recording. We'll provide the script and upload link.

Maria (People Ops): IT note: we can provision cloud dev accounts immediately but physical badge and corporate laptop shipment are blocked until I-9 verification recorded. Sam, can you hold the device at the shipping vendor?

Sam (IT): Yup — I can place the order but mark "hold for verification". I can release within 24 hours after Maria confirms. Remote VPN and SSO will stay off until verification passes.

Onboard-Bot: BG case BG-9202 created. Status: docs-needed.

Rita (New Hire): Thanks — I'll do the video at 7pm BRT. Where do I upload the recording? Also do you need a notarized affidavit afterwards?

Diego (HR Partner): Upload to this secure intake link: https://files.redwood.com/onboard-intake. For Brazil e-notary isn't widely used, so video + renewal receipt should suffice for initial verification; we'll follow up if Legal requests a consulate notary.

Maria (People Ops): Quick attestation script (copy/paste):

"I, [full name], confirm that the passport and CPF card shown in this recording are my documents. I consent to Redwood Inference storing this recording for onboarding and verification purposes."

Diego (HR Partner): I'll record the exception in the Onboarding Exceptions sheet under tag "intl-cpf-passport-mismatch" and note start-date status: full start date kept, benefits enrollment deferred 1 pay cycle pending verification.

Sam (IT): Noted. I'll queue the laptop but won't generate the shipping label until I get the green from Maria. Cloud accounts ready; I will DM Rita about MFA setup window.

Rita (New Hire): Uploaded renewal receipt and confirmed slot. Will record and upload after the call. Thank you! :pray:

Maria (People Ops): Plan: video call tonight, HR saves recording, legal reviews, update BG case, then IT ships. Benefits and badge activation on a ~48hr hold. I'll post back when recording is uploaded. :white_check_mark:
